title: Create Basic MCP Server Structure
description: Implement basic MCP server using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk with stdio transport. Server must initialize correctly, stdio transport configured, server can be started via npm script, and basic error handling in place.
details: Sprint 0 - Project Setup. Creates the core MCP server infrastructure that all other tools will build upon.
testStrategy: Server initializes without errors, stdio transport works, npm start script executes successfully.
